details.description: Claude Sonnet 5 is Anthropic's current Sonnet-tier model, released June 30, 2026 as a drop-in upgrade to Claude Sonnet 4.6. Anthropic describes it as the most agentic Sonnet model yet, able to make plans and use tools such as browsers and terminals autonomously at a level that previously required larger, more expensive models. It has a 1-million-token context window, vision input, and adaptive thinking on by default, and Anthropic positions it close to the larger Claude Opus 4.8 on knowledge work and agentic coding at a lower price.
advantages: Scores 63.2% on SWE-bench Pro, an agentic coding benchmark (DataCamp, reporting Anthropic's benchmark results; independently corroborated by other reporting on Anthropic's figures).
Scores 80.4% on Terminal-Bench 2.1 and 81.2% on OSWorld-Verified, an agentic terminal-use and a computer-use benchmark respectively (DataCamp, reporting Anthropic's benchmark results).
Scores 57.4% (with tools) on Humanity's Last Exam, a multidisciplinary reasoning evaluation (DataCamp, reporting Anthropic's benchmark results).
Anthropic reports testers found it 'checks its own output without explicitly being asked' and finishes complex tasks where earlier versions stopped short (Anthropic launch post).
disadvantages: Anthropic states it has 'much lower ability to perform cybersecurity tasks than current Opus models' and recommends Claude Opus 4.8 for cybersecurity work needing reduced guardrails (Anthropic launch post).
Neither Sonnet model Anthropic tested could develop a working exploit in its cybersecurity evaluation, scoring 0.0% (Anthropic launch post).
Shows somewhat higher rates of misaligned behavior than Claude Opus 4.8, per Anthropic's own alignment assessment (Anthropic launch post).
Uses an updated tokenizer that can map the same input to roughly 1.0-1.35x more tokens than Sonnet 4.6, depending on content type (Anthropic launch post).
use_cases: Agentic planning and autonomous multi-step task execution
Tool use with browsers and terminals

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 5: Features, Benchmarks, and Pricing

notes: Catalog's deprecation_date fact (2026-12-24) does not match Anthropic's own model-deprecations table and platform.claude.com overview page, which both give a tentative retirement 'Not sooner than June 30, 2027' (exactly one year after the June 30, 2026 release -- the same pattern seen on every other Claude snapshot checked in this batch). Kept the catalog's value per instructions but flagging the roughly six-month discrepancy. Catalog's 1M max input / 128K max output tokens and image+text-in/text-out modality match platform.claude.com's specs table exactly. Anthropic's own launch post's readable prose and footnotes gave only one hard number (0.0% on a cybersecurity exploit-development eval); its main capability benchmark table is an unreadable chart image and its system-card PDF was too large to fetch, so the coding/reasoning scores above are sourced to DataCamp's write-up of the same system card instead. The 63.2% SWE-bench Pro figure was independently corroborated by other reporting.
